Terminal Interface: MTK-0005
Query Details: Schedule — Yabuli — Related Schedule; To Nearest Available Time Slot
Access Level: Class-A Clearance

※ System Notice ※:
The following content has not been filtered for external distribution. Handle all visitors and emergencies in accordance with relevant group policies. Do not disclose specific schedules.
Information will be calculated from the time of query and expressed as timestamps, with days as the minimum unit.

D0 – D15        Experiment
[ACCESS DENIED] Stage 3 of the experiment progress. To fulfill the company's quarterly assessment goals and lobby for increased R&D funding for the Technology Department, embryos naturally requiring a six-month incubation cycle are being forced through in two and a half weeks. A risk of system collapse remains present. Access forbidden during this timeframe.

D16 – D17         Experiment
[ACCESS DENIED] Final stage of the experiment progress. Per the requirements of the Astropolis Eco Science Committee, attempts are being made to achieve an 85% biodegradable composite state. Access restricted.

D18 Morning      Business/Administration
The 17th regular meeting for the semi-annual financial report review and budget allocation, focusing on the fourth assessment (second-to-last) of the proposed 5% budget increase submitted 130 days ago.

D18 Afternoon         Assessment      (3rd Postponement)
Structural Resonance Diversity Survey, Laboratory No. 13.
※ Cable installation passes through Laboratories No. 14 and No. 12 as well as Information Center Zone 3, raising questions of asset ownership. See Meeting Minutes on Further Implementation of the Wall-Penetration Feasibility Study.

D19 – D35         Experiment
New Resource [ACCESS DENIED] Phase 2 observation period: 16 days. The institute enters high-pressure operations. The director will not receive visitors unless necessary. Access requests from anyone outside Genius Society members, staff ranked P40 or above, or those on the whitelist will be declined.
※ During this period, the system may automatically dispatch a large volume of orders to biological material suppliers of a commercial partnership nature. If you receive a confirmation call, disregard any obvious discrepancies in the accounts and reply uniformly: "Order confirmed and valid. Thank you for reaching out."

D32 Afternoon          Interview
Keeping Up With Astropolis Program Team
※ Interview conducted by Terminal MTK-0002 on behalf of the director. Not included in the director's schedule. For external reference purposes only.

D36 – D145   Experiment Preparation
Building on the results of experiment [ACCESS DENIED], a 100-day period has been reserved as the full project evaluation phase. During this time, five inspection and testing reports must be obtained, written approval from the relevant committee must be secured, and the annual budget allocation must be approved.

※ Apply Reception Protocol β. Wispae Eco-Park Sections 3–5 are reserved and available. Confirm dining supply reserves in advance, and ensure the underground elevator remains sealed and out of sight.
